requirements.gap: Need exact historical normalized-income RAY values, block/hash/timestamp and upgrade-specific ABI. Last-year APY does not demonstrate complete fixed-period coverage.
Need causal cost estimates for comparable supply/withdraw, initial allowance where needed, and ETH/USD. Receipts are actual past costs, not automatic hypothetical fill costs.
Need USDC historical executable bid/ask with reserve identity and time. Do not assume peg equals one or substitute an oracle mark for execution.
Need available underlying balance and reserve flags at entry and exit, bound to deployed versions. Frozen and paused are not interchangeable. Unavailable exit remains open exposure.
Ethereum v3 launch dated 2023-01-27; exact USDC activation block not verified. No v3 operating history before launch; no substitution of v2 or fake warmup.
At most nine complete serial 30-day final positions vs minimum thirty; single-USDC positive-profit share is 100% vs 25% cap. Not an empirical negative verdict.

reentry_condition: A genuinely new verified input may enable an explicitly descriptive study, but cannot remove the frozen acceptance conflict. A change of acceptance contract is a separate substantive decision, not an automatic technical rebind.
